subject: stroke property does not work with layer_lines() and x-axis of class date

messages.author: af44a577d9ff08de
messages.subject: stroke property does not work with layer_lines() and x-axis of class date
parts:
Hi,

Hopefully the following example will illustrate the problem. Happy to provide further details if necessary:

library(dplyr)
library(ggvis)

sessionInfo()

# R version 3.0.2 (2013-09-25)
# Platform: x86_64-redhat-linux-gnu (64-bit)
# 
# locale:
# [1] C
# 
# attached base packages:
# [1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base     
# 
# other attached packages:
# [1] ggvis_0.2.0.99 dplyr_0.2      rjson_0.2.13  
# 
# loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
# [1] RJSONIO_1.0-3    Rcpp_0.11.1      assertthat_0.1   bitops_1.0-6     caTools_1.16     digest_0.6.4     httpuv_1.2.3    
# [8] magrittr_1.1.0   parallel_3.0.2   shiny_0.9.1.9008 tools_3.0.2      xtable_1.7-1

set.seed(20)

dates <- seq(Sys.Date(), by = -1, length = 10)
index <- 1:10

double <- function(x) c(x, x)

tbl <- data.frame(
  date = double(dates),
  index = double(index),  
  val = runif(20),
  group = rep(c("a", "b"), each = 10)
)

# OK
tbl %>%
  ggvis(~index, ~val, stroke = ~group) %>%
  layer_lines() %>%
  layer_points(fill = ~group)

# not OK
# points seems to be correct; lines are incorrect
tbl %>%
  ggvis(~date, ~val, stroke = ~group) %>%
  layer_lines %>%
  layer_points(fill = ~group)

Cheers,

Guy

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: stroke property does not work with layer_lines() and x-axis of class date
parts:
It looks like it's due to rounding error in the conversion of values to JSON. For example, the resulting spec contains this:
{
"date" : 1.3993e+12,
"val" : 0.37007,
"group" : "a"
},
{
"date" : 1.3994e+12,
"val" : 0.32759,
"group" : "a"
}

Do you mind filing an issue in the tracker?
https://github.com/rstudio/ggvis/issues

Thanks!
-Winston
